title: Private Ephesus Shore Excursion – On-Time Cruise Return
summary:
Discover the wonders of ancient Ephesus with AXU TOURS on a private shore excursion designed for cruise passengers arriving at Kusadasi Port.

Explore the magnificent ruins of Ephesus, visit the House of the Virgin Mary and discover the Temple of Artemis with your private licensed guide.

Enjoy comfortable transportation, a flexible itinerary tailored to your cruise schedule and a personalized experience without mandatory shopping stops.
itinerary: Kusadasi Cruise Port Pickup — Meet your private guide at the agreed meeting point near Kusadasi Cruise Port. Begin your journey in a comfortable, air-conditioned private vehicle.
House of the Virgin Mary — Visit the peaceful pilgrimage site on Mount Koressos, traditionally associated with the final years of the Virgin Mary. Suggested visit: 40–45 minutes.

Ancient City of Ephesus — Discover one of the most remarkable archaeological sites of the ancient Mediterranean world. Explore the Library of Celsus, Great Theatre, Curetes Street, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan and other important archaeological remains. Your licensed guide will introduce you to the history, architecture and daily life of ancient Ephesus. Suggested visit: approximately 2 hours.
Temple of Artemis — Visit the remains of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Suggested visit: 15–20 minutes.

Optional Experiences — Depending on available time and guest preferences, add the Terrace Houses, Basilica of St. John or a local lunch. Optional activities and entrance fees may require additional arrangements.

Return to Kusadasi Cruise Port — Enjoy a comfortable return transfer to the cruise port. The return time will be planned around the ship's scheduled departure. No mandatory carpet, leather or souvenir shopping stops.

title: Private Pamukkale & Hierapolis Tour from Kusadasi Port or Hotels
summary:
Discover Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis on a private day tour from Kusadasi. Travel with a sightseeing vehicle and licensed guide reserved exclusively for your party, with pickup and return at the agreed cruise-port meeting point or hotel.

Explore the natural landscape and archaeological remains, enjoy a local lunch and discover regional craftsmanship during a local handicrafts presentation and shopping stop.

For cruise guests, availability and the itinerary are confirmed only after reviewing the ship’s arrival and all-aboard times.

title: Private Pergamon & Asklepion Tour from Izmir
summary:
Discover the remarkable ancient city of Pergamon and its renowned healing sanctuary, the Asklepion, on a private day tour from Izmir.

Explore the impressive Acropolis, admire the dramatic setting of the ancient theatre, and discover the remains of temples and monumental buildings that reflect Pergamon's importance in the ancient world.

Continue to the Asklepion, one of the most celebrated healing centres of antiquity, and learn about ancient medical traditions and the legacy of Galen.

Enjoy a journey through the archaeological and cultural heritage of western Türkiye with a professional guide

itinerary.title: Departure from Izmir
itinerary.description: Begin the private day tour from Izmir and travel towards Bergama according to the arrangements confirmed in your quotation. The agreed pickup or meeting point, transfer type and any airport transfer must be specified before booking.

itinerary.title: Pergamon Acropolis
itinerary.description: Explore the Acropolis and its archaeological remains, including the steep hillside theatre, the sanctuary of Athena, the Trajaneum and other monumental remains. Access and the walking route depend on site conditions.

itinerary.title: Great Altar Foundations
itinerary.description: See the foundations and archaeological setting associated with Pergamon's Great Altar. The Great Altar itself is not at the ancient site; it is held at the Pergamonmuseum in Berlin.

itinerary.title: Asklepion
itinerary.description: Continue to the Asklepion, the ancient healing sanctuary outside the Acropolis. Learn about its historical medical traditions and Pergamon-born physician Galen; this is a historical visit, not a health or treatment service.

itinerary.title: Lunch Stop
itinerary.description: A lunch break can be scheduled during the day. Whether lunch is included, and the restaurant and meal arrangements, must be stated in your quotation.

itinerary.title: Return to Izmir
itinerary.description: Return towards Izmir and the drop-off point specified in the confirmed package. Airport and port transfers, their type and any extra charges require explicit confirmation.

title: Priene, Miletus & Didyma Tour from Kusadasi
summary:
Discover three remarkable archaeological sites on a full-day journey from Kusadasi. Explore Priene’s ancient streets and the remains of its Temple of Athena, discover the theatre and archaeological landscape of Miletus, and visit the monumental Temple of Apollo at Didyma.

Travel with a licensed guide and air-conditioned transportation, with a local restaurant lunch and return transfers included.

itinerary.description: Visit the monumental sanctuary of Apollo, known for its ancient oracle and impressive surviving architectural remains.

title: Private Sirince Village & Local Traditions Tour from Izmir
summary:
Escape the busy city and discover the charming hillside village of Sirince on a private excursion from Izmir.

Wander through narrow cobblestone streets, admire traditional houses, and explore the village's rich cultural heritage and peaceful countryside atmosphere.

Discover local shops offering regional products, handmade crafts, olive oil and traditional preserves. Enjoy free time to explore at your own pace, relax at a village café or browse the charming streets.

Experience a different side of western Türkiye, where traditional village life, history and local culture come together.

title: Private Seven Churches of Revelation Tour
summary:
Trace the Seven Churches of Revelation on a private five-day journey through western Türkiye. Explore the places associated with Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamon, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea, with guided visits that connect the ancient landscape to early Christian history.

Travel from Izmir to Bergama and Akhisar, continue through the ancient cities of Lydia to Pamukkale, then discover Ephesus and the Christian heritage of Selcuk. The itinerary also includes the House of the Virgin Mary, the Basilica of St. John and Hierapolis.

With private transportation, an English-speaking guide, four nights of accommodation and Izmir Airport transfers, this journey brings together biblical heritage and archaeology. Your final itinerary, hotels and service arrangements will be detailed in your quotation.

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Arrival in Izmir
itinerary.description: Meet your representative at Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to rest after your journey or explore independently. Izmir, ancient Smyrna, is one of the seven cities addressed in Revelation and provides the starting point for your journey. No guided sightseeing is scheduled on arrival day. Overnight in Izmir.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Pergamon, Thyatira and Smyrna
itinerary.description: Travel to Bergama to explore Pergamon Acropolis and the Asklepion. Stop for an exterior photograph of the Red Basilica before continuing to Akhisar, ancient Thyatira, to discover the surviving archaeological remains and learn about its early Christian community. Return to Izmir for a panoramic introduction to ancient Smyrna and the modern city, including the Clock Tower area. The Smyrna element is a city introduction; entry to a specific church or the Agora is not included unless expressly confirmed in your quotation. Overnight in Izmir.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea and Hierapolis
itinerary.description: Depart Izmir for Sardis, the ancient Lydian capital, and continue to Alasehir, ancient Philadelphia, to see the surviving remains associated with the city's Christian heritage. Travel onward to Laodicea near Denizli to explore its archaeological landscape and discuss the community addressed in Revelation. Continue to Hierapolis in the Pamukkale area. This is a full sightseeing day with substantial road travel; the visit order and time at each site will be planned around opening hours and local conditions. Overnight in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Ephesus and the Christian Heritage of Selcuk
itinerary.description: Travel from Pamukkale to the Selcuk area. Visit the House of the Virgin Mary, traditionally associated with Mary's later life, and explore Ephesus with your guide, including the Celsus Library, Curetes Street and Great Theatre. Learn about the early Christian community of Ephesus before visiting the Basilica of St. John. These later pilgrimage landmarks complement the Seven Churches story and are distinct from the original congregations addressed in Revelation. Overnight in Kusadasi or Selcuk, as confirmed in your quotation.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Departure from Izmir
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport for your onward flight. Pickup time will be arranged according to your confirmed flight and hotel location. Flights are not included in the tour.

Three lunches and one dinner during the programme; the specific days and menus will be stated in your quotation.
Departure-day breakfast, as listed in the itinerary. The breakfast arrangements for other days will be stated in your quotation.
